body:
_Migrated from issue #1007, filed 2026-07-19._ Follow-up from [#855](https://github.com/new-usemame/Calibre-Web-NextGen/issues/855) (@monimkxl-web) and already flagged as a v2 item during the review of #975. v4.1.17 added the series name and position under the title/author on book cards, which covered the "I can't see which series a book belongs to" half of the report. The other half — "so I can't **display** a series" — is still open: the series line renders as plain text (`frontend/src/components/BookCard.tsx`, the `

`), so there is no way to get from a card to that series' page. ## Ask Make the series line navigate to the series (`/app/series/:id`). ## Care needed The whole card is already an interactive control, so a naive nested `` creates a nested-interactive a11y violation and an ambiguous click target. Worth deciding deliberately between: - a real link that stops event propagation, positioned above the card's own click layer, or - keeping the card as the only control and surfacing the series link on the book detail page instead. Whichever way it goes it needs a keyboard pass (tab order, focus ring) and an `a11y.spec.ts` assertion, plus a check at 375px where the card is tightest. Credit: reported by [@monimkxl-web](https://github.com/monimkxl-web).
title: [New UI] Make the series line on book cards a link to the series
